idea-plugin.name: CORS Policy Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Warning icon on any Java/Kotlin Spring @CrossOrigin(origins = "*", allowCredentials = "true") annotation (class- or method-level) -- this exact combination is forbidden by the CORS spec itself: browsers reject a wildcard origin combined with credentials, so requests silently fail (or, worse, the intent behind the annotation is misunderstood entirely).

Also covers the programmatic WebMvcConfigurer registration -- registry.addMapping(...) .allowedOrigins("*").allowCredentials(true) -- as a single-statement fluent chain, regardless of call order.

100% static PSI analysis -- matches by simple name only, works whether the real Spring jar is on the classpath or not. Java and Kotlin.

Stated honestly: does not cover a CorsConfigurationSource/ UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource setup where the wildcard origin and the credentials flag are set on separate statements against a CorsConfiguration object built up over multiple lines.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
